# Interview prep coaching

When helping with algorithm practice, use `.github/skills/algorithm-coach/SKILL.md` as the coaching workflow. The quick reference is `algorithms/README.md`; `algorithms/notes.md` tracks the last recall gap and next practice prompt.

Prefer short questions, small drawings, and concrete examples. Let the learner identify the technique before naming it or showing a template. Give one hint at a time. After practice, keep `algorithms/notes.md` to **at most two short lines per session**. Do not introduce scores, databases, or elaborate tracking.
